name: Nyotai Kyouran 3 -Chaos Body-
original_name: 女体狂乱3 －カオスボディ－
source:
The empress is dead. The empire is collapsed. 
All is in ruins at the hands of the possessed doctor being puppeted by the demon king. 
Hoping to spare her empress, a young girl throws herself upon the doctor's mad sword! 

Transformed in body and lewdness, she "becums"... deformed... 
feast your eyes on new body dysmorphia, from mega tits to hyperphallus, 
giant ovaries, full body rubber, birth demonism...! and more! 

One girl takes all the changes like a gumby porn queen! 

In the end will she get revenge for her mutations or go mad with orgasms?
